ROOT CAUSE of round-trip: rng._raw() stored a,b,c,d as SIGNED int32 (| ^ << all yield signed); loadRngState() normalised with >>>0. Verified offline over 207 seeds x 2000 draws: 207/207 seeds hold a negative word at some point; only 1337 and 60606 are all-positive immediately after reseed — exactly the critic's two passing seeds.
PROOF the >>>0 fix is stream-preserving: 0 value mismatches across 207 seeds x 2000 draws (scratchpad/rng-check.mjs).

R5 decomposition (own analysis): state_entered_f differs because LATER transitions are window-relative (offset by the warm-up delta) while the FIRST transition is warm-up-absolute. A single subtraction cannot fix both; a 'pre-window' sentinel for negative re-based indices fixes both. anim_frame is fixed by a scenario-contract re-anchor (critic's own option 3), NOT by exclusion.

makeRecord IS called from Engine._step, which is the FixedLoop.step callback invoked inside FixedLoop.stepOnce()'s timed window -> the critic's stack makeRecord<-_step<-stepOnce<-stepFrames is correct.
save-manifest treats world.entities as ONE leaf path (leafPaths stops at arrays), so adding a per-entity field does not break RI-JRN05 M4.

PROVEN HARD FAIL 2: seed-sweep.mjs against the PRE-FIX rng gives 36/40 first-trip mismatches, passing seeds exactly [1337, 60606] — identical to the verdict. POST-FIX 0/40 mismatches, 40/40 words uint32.

First seeded-phase attempt gave only 4.7% (just under the 5% bar) because stagger recovery reset animFrame to 0, erasing the seeded phase after 168 frames. Fixed by resuming at e.animPhase0.
